lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 vertical columns of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. These clusters are arranged in a structured grid, with the largest and most intense blobs located along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs. The circular high-luminance nodes are centered within these vertical bands, creating a highly organized grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from a high-intensity light edge (superior) to a shadowed low-intensity edge (inferior), indicating a structural ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs within the dorsal fin silhouette, primarily concentrated toward the posterior margin and upper apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent and unique swirling, concentric circular marking is visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, resembling a fingerprint or vortex pattern of altered pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, uniform clustering of small, high-intensity spots that differ in spatial frequency and size compared to the primary flank constellation.
